N001.summary: Early game (around 180s) with both players on heavy economy and expansion. Terran shows ground posture with Marines/Reapers, moderate production, heavy tech. Zerg has Zerglings/Queens, moderate production, light tech. Continue expanding and increasing economy. Strengthen your ground army with additional Zerglings and Queens for defense. Maintain scouting to detect Terran tech transitions. Consider adding a Spawning Pool and starting Lair tech soon to unlock more options.
